title.zh: 第一 律曆上 律準 候氣
title.en: Volume 91: Rhythm and the Calendar Part One
title.raw: 第一 律曆上 律準 候氣 Volume 91: Rhythm and the Calendar Part One

sentences.zh: 後漢書志第一 律曆上 律準候氣

translations.literal: Later Han Treatises part one: Pitch standards and calendar part one—pitch regulators and qi observation.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise I of the Later Han: musical pitch (upper scroll)—regulators for tuning pipes and the qi-detection method.

sentences.zh: 古之人論數也，曰：「物生而後有象，像而後有滋，滋而後有數」。

translations.literal: The ancients, discussing number, said: “Things arise and then there are images; from images there is growth; from growth there are numbers.”
translations.idiomatic: Ancient thinkers defined reckoning in stages: beings yield forms, forms yield proliferation, and only then do numbers apply.

sentences.zh: 然則天地初形，人物既著，則筭數之事生矣。

translations.literal: Thus once heaven and earth first took shape and human beings stood forth, the arts of counting began.
translations.idiomatic: Once heaven, earth, and humanity existed, mathematics followed inevitably.

sentences.zh: 記稱大橈作甲子[1]，隸首作數[2]。

translations.literal: Records name Da Nao as creator of the sexagenary cycle note one and Li Shou as creator of numeration note two.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition credits Da Nao with the stem-branch cycle note one and Li Shou with systematic numbering note two.

sentences.zh: 二者既立，以比日表[3]，以管萬事。

translations.literal: With both established they matched solar shadows note three and governed the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Those tools calibrated gnomon shadows note three and ordered every administrative reckoning.

sentences.zh: 夫一、十、百、千、萬，所同用也；

translations.literal: One, ten, hundred, thousand, and myriad are what all reckonings share;
translations.idiomatic: Digits from one through myriad underpin every tally;

sentences.zh: 律、度、量、衡、歷，其別用也。

translations.literal: pitch pipes, length, capacity, weight, and calendar are where applications diverge.
translations.idiomatic: but pitch, linear measure, volume, balance, and celestial reckoning each branch separately.

sentences.zh: 故體有長短，檢以度[4]；

translations.literal: Hence bodies have length—checked by graduated rules note four;
translations.idiomatic: Bodies are gauged with rulers note four;

sentences.zh: 物有多少，受以量[5]；

translations.literal: things come in quantity—received into vessels note five;
translations.idiomatic: bulk is poured into standard measures note five;

sentences.zh: 量有輕重，平以權衡[6]；

translations.literal: loads differ in weight—balanced by steelyards note six;
translations.idiomatic: weight rests on beam balances note six;

sentences.zh: 聲有清濁，協以律呂；

translations.literal: tones differ in clarity or dullness—harmonized through the twelve pitch-classes;
translations.idiomatic: sound divides into clear and muddy tones harmonized by the pitch-cycle;

sentences.zh: 三光運行，紀以歷數：然後幽隱之情，精微之變，可得而綜也[7]。

translations.literal: the three luminaries wheel overhead—registered by calendrical numbers: after this hidden tendencies and subtle transformations may be grasped in synthesis note seven.
translations.idiomatic: sun, moon, and stars ride calendrical mathematics note seven until even arcane shifts yield to systematic grasp.

sentences.zh: 漢興，北平侯張蒼首治律歷。

translations.literal: When Han arose Marquis Zhang Cang of Beiping first regulated pitch pipes and the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynastic founding Zhang Cang of Beiping Marquis reorganized harmonics and astronomy.

sentences.zh: 孝武正樂，置協律之官。

translations.literal: Filial Emperor Wu corrected ritual music and founded offices for harmonizing pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu standardized court music and appointed specialists to tune the bells.

sentences.zh: 至元始中，博徵通知鐘律者，考其意義，羲和劉歆典領條奏，前史班固取以為志。

translations.literal: By the Yuanshi era court broadly summoned masters versed in bells and pitch, examined their doctrines, and Astronomy Director Liu Xin drafted systematic memorials that Former Han historian Ban Gu excerpted into his treatises.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshi-era commissions collected tuning theory; Liu Xin’s Directorate of Astronomy codified it for the throne, and Ban Gu folded that dossier into his monographs.

sentences.zh: 而元帝時，郎中京房，房字君明，知五聲之音，六律之數。

translations.literal: Meanwhile under Yuan Emperor, palace attendant Jing Fang—styled Junming—mastered the five degrees of tone and the mathematics of the six pitch-classes.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant Jing Fang (Junming), contemporary with Yuan Emperor, knew the five tones and six-pitch arithmetic inside out.

sentences.zh: 上使太子太傅韋玄成、字少翁諫議大夫章，雜試問房於樂府。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered heir-apparent tutor Wei Xuancheng—styled Shao Weng—and advisory counselor Zhang to examine Fang jointly inside the Bureau of Music.
translations.idiomatic: The throne tasked Wei Xuancheng and Counselor Zhang with cross-examining him at the imperial conservatory.

sentences.zh: 房對：「受學故小黃令焦延壽。

translations.literal: Fang replied: “My teacher was former district magistrate of Xiaohuang Jiao Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: Fang answered: “I studied under former Xiaohuang magistrate Jiao Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 六十律相生之法：以上生下，皆三生二，以下生上，皆三生四，陽下生陰，陰上生陽，終於中呂，而十二律畢矣。

translations.literal: The mutual-production rule among sixty pitch-classes: generating downward from high always applies thrice-two reduction; generating upward from low always applies thrice-four augmentation; yang generates yin below and yin generates yang above, finishing at Zhonglü so the twelve pipes complete.”
translations.idiomatic: Sixty-pitch derivation uses three-halves downward steps and four-thirds upward steps until Zhonglü closes the duodecimal set.”

sentences.zh: 中呂上生執始，執始下生去滅，上下相生，終於南事，六十律畢矣。

translations.literal: “Zhonglü generates Zhishi above; Zhishi generates Qumie below; alternating above and below production ends at Nanshi, completing sixty tones.”
translations.idiomatic: “Zhonglü ascends to Zhishi, Zhishi descends to Qumie, and the ladder finishes at Nanshi—sixty names in all.”

sentences.zh: 夫十二律之變至於六十，猶八卦之變至於六十四也。

translations.literal: Twelve pitch-classes ramifying to sixty parallels how eight trigrams ramify to sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve pipes blooming into sixty notes mirrors eight trigrams blooming into sixty-four hexagrams.

sentences.zh: 宓羲作易，紀陽氣之初，以為律法。

translations.literal: Fuxi composed the Changes, marking the first emergence of yang qi to serve as law for pitch computation.
translations.idiomatic: Fuxi’s Zhou yi anchors yang qi’s primal emergence—the same logic pitch computation follows.

sentences.zh: 建日冬至之聲，以黃鐘為宮，太蔟為商，姑洗為角，林鐘為徵，南呂為羽，應鐘為變宮，蕤賓為變徵[8]。

translations.literal: Naming the sound that belongs to the winter solstice jian day: Huangzhong serves as gong, Taicu as shang, Guxian as jue, Linzhong as zhi, Nanlü as yu, Yingzhong as altered gong, Ruibin as altered zhi note eight.
translations.idiomatic: On the jian day of midwinter you tune Huangzhong to keynote gong, slot Taicu as shang, Guxian as jue, Linzhong as zhi, Nanlü as yu, Yingzhong as biangong, Ruibin as bianzhi note eight.

sentences.zh: 此聲氣之元，五音之正也。

translations.literal: These are the root of tone-breath and the orthodox alignment of the pentatonic scale.
translations.idiomatic: That cluster forms the acoustic foundation and canonical pentatonic template.

sentences.zh: 故各終一日。

translations.literal: Thus each rules one full day.
translations.idiomatic: Each configuration therefore governs an entire day.

sentences.zh: 其餘以次運行，當日者各自為宮，而商徵以類從焉[9]。

translations.literal: The remainder rotate in sequence; whichever tone sits on the given day becomes gong for that day while shang and zhi follow by category note nine.
translations.idiomatic: Other days rotate the pattern; the daily tonic becomes gong while shang and zhi shift by analogy note nine.

sentences.zh: 禮運篇曰『五聲、六律、十二管還相為宮』，此之謂也[10]。

translations.literal: The “Evolution of Rites” chapter says “five tones, six pitch-classes, and twelve pipes succeed one another as gong”—this is what it means note ten.
translations.idiomatic: The Liyun line about twelve tubes cyclically serving as keynote captures exactly this note ten.

sentences.zh: 以六十律分朞之日，黃鐘自冬至始，及冬至而復，陰陽寒燠風雨之占生焉。

translations.literal: Apportioning the sixty pitch-classes across the days of the cycle: Huangzhong opens at winter solstice and returns there; omens of yin-yang, cold, heat, wind, and rain arise from it.
translations.idiomatic: Splitting sixty tones across the calendar begins and ends at Huangzhong on midwinter day, feeding weather divination.

sentences.zh: 於以檢攝羣音，考其高下，苟非草木之聲，則無不有所合。

translations.literal: With it one reins in every sounding note, compares relative height, and except for sounds from plants or trees nothing fails to register agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Against that grid every musical tone lines up unless it is mere rustling vegetation.

sentences.zh: 虞書曰『律和聲』，此之謂也。」

translations.literal: The Shang shu says “pitch harmonizes sound”—this is the sense intended.”
translations.idiomatic: “Thus,” he concluded, “the Documents command pitch to harmonize voice.””

sentences.zh: 房又曰：「竹聲不可以度調，故作準以定數。

translations.literal: Fang added: “Bamboo pipes cannot be regulated by abstract measure, so I fashioned a pitch regulator to fix the numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Fang continued: “Because bamboo defies abstract calibration, I built a tuning regulator to nail the ratios.

sentences.zh: 準之狀如瑟，長丈而十三弦，隱閒九尺，以應黃鐘之律九寸；

translations.literal: Shaped like a se zither, one zhang long with thirteen strings, its concealed span nine chi matching Huangzhong’s nine cun pipe;
translations.idiomatic: It resembles a se: thirteen strings over one zhang, nine chi of vibrating length answering Huangzhong’s nine-cun tube;

sentences.zh: 中央一弦，下有畫分寸，以為六十律清濁之節。

translations.literal: the central string bears ruled inch-marks below as gradations for the sixty pitch-classes’ bright or dull nodes.
translations.idiomatic: its middle string carries engraved fen and cun used to mark every bright or dull step among sixty tones.

sentences.zh: 」房言律詳於歆所奏，其術施行於史官，候部用之。

translations.literal: ” Fang’s exposition exceeded Xin’s memorial in detail; his method operated in the archives and the qi-watch offices adopted it.
translations.idiomatic: His theory ran deeper than Liu Xin’s submission and became standard for historians and seasonal qi observers.

sentences.zh: 文多不悉載。

translations.literal: The text is too lengthy to copy entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Most detail is omitted here for length.

sentences.zh: 故總其本要，以續前志。

translations.literal: Therefore I summarize the essentials to extend the prior treatise.
translations.idiomatic: This section condenses the core to continue the earlier monograph.

sentences.zh: 律術曰：陽以圓為形，其性動。

translations.literal: Pitch doctrine says: yang takes the circle as its figure and its nature is active.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonic theory: yang manifests as round motion and tends toward movement.

sentences.zh: 陰以方為節，其性靜。

translations.literal: Yin takes the square as its norm and its nature is still.
translations.idiomatic: Yin squares itself into boundaries and stays quiescent.

sentences.zh: 動者數三，靜者數二。

translations.literal: What moves counts by three; what rests counts by two.
translations.idiomatic: Active numbers ride three; static numbers ride two.

sentences.zh: 以陽生陰，倍之；

translations.literal: When yang begets yin, double it;
translations.idiomatic: Yang generating yin doubles the prior value;

sentences.zh: 以陰生陽，四之：皆三而一。

translations.literal: when yin begets yang, quadruple it—both cases divide by three once.
translations.idiomatic: yin generating yang multiplies by four before the universal division by three.

sentences.zh: 陽生陰曰下生，陰生陽曰上生。

translations.literal: Yang producing yin is called lower generation; yin producing yang is called upper generation.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generation lowers the pipe; up-generation raises it.

sentences.zh: 上生不得過黃鐘之清濁，下生不得及黃鐘之數實。

translations.literal: Upper generation must not exceed Huangzhong’s bright or dull limit; lower generation must not fall short of Huangzhong’s numerical solidity.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending steps cannot surpass Huangzhong’s upper bound; descending steps cannot undershoot its canonical mass-number.

sentences.zh: 皆參天兩地，圓蓋方覆，六耦承奇之道也。

translations.literal: All this mirrors “three parts heaven, two parts earth,” round heaven covering square earth—paired even forces bearing odd potency.
translations.idiomatic: The arithmetic embodies heaven-three earth-two, dome over square plane, even couples lifting odd centers.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘，律呂之首，而生十二律者也[11]。

translations.literal: Huangzhong heads the pitch-cycle and begets the twelve classes note eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhong seeds every subsequent pipe note eleven.

sentences.zh: 其相生也，皆三分而損益之。

translations.literal: Their mutual production always applies thirding with subtraction or addition.
translations.idiomatic: Each link applies the classical subtract-one-third or add-one-third rule.

sentences.zh: 是故十二律之，得十七萬七千一百四十七，是為黃鐘之實[12]。

translations.literal: Hence working through the twelve pitch-values yields 177,147, which is Huangzhong’s solidity note twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve iterations therefore pile to 177,147—the canonical Huangzhong “solid” note twelve.

sentences.zh: 又以二乘而三約之，是為下生林鐘之實。

translations.literal: Multiply by two and divide by three to obtain the solidity for Linzhong generated below.
translations.idiomatic: Two-thirds of that mass defines down-generated Linzhong.

sentences.zh: 又以四乘而三約之，是為上生太蔟之實。

translations.literal: Multiply by four and divide by three to obtain the solidity for Taicu generated above.
translations.idiomatic: Four-thirds steps back upward to Taicu’s mass.

sentences.zh: 推此上下，以定六十律之實。

translations.literal: Extend this alternation to settle the solidity figures for all sixty pipes.
translations.idiomatic: Repeat the ladder to enumerate sixty tonal solids.

sentences.zh: 以九三之，數萬九千六百八十三為法。

translations.literal: Divide repeatedly by nine-cubed (729); 19,683 becomes the divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Use 19,683—nine cubed times three—as the modular divisor.

sentences.zh: 律為寸，於準為尺。

translations.literal: Where pitch reads in cun the regulator reads in chi.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe lengths translate to chi on the regulator at ten-to-one scale.

sentences.zh: 不盈者十之，所得為分。

translations.literal: Remainders scale by tens to yield fen.
translations.idiomatic: Fractional remainders become fen by decimal promotion.

sentences.zh: 又不盈十之，所得為小分。

translations.literal: Still indivisible remainders scale again by ten for small fen.
translations.idiomatic: Smaller scraps refine again into micro-fen.

sentences.zh: 以其餘正其強弱。

translations.literal: Use the leftover bits to calibrate relative strength or weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Residual micro-units mark acoustic strong or weak bias.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘，十七萬七千一百四十七。

translations.literal: Huangzhong: 177,147.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhong solid: 177,147.

sentences.zh: 下生林鐘。

translations.literal: Generates Linzhong below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Linzhong.

sentences.zh: 黃鐘為宮，太蔟商，林鐘徵。

translations.literal: Huangzhong as gong, Taicu as shang, Linzhong as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Huangzhong tonic, Taicu shang, Linzhong zhi.

sentences.zh: 一日律九寸，準九尺。

translations.literal: Pipe length nine cun; regulator length nine chi.
translations.idiomatic: Nine cun on the pipe, nine chi on the regulator.

sentences.zh: 色育，十七萬六千七百七十六。

translations.idiomatic: Seyu solid: 176,776.

sentences.zh: 下生謙待。

translations.literal: Generates Qiandai below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Qiandai.

sentences.zh: 色育為宮，未知商，謙待徵。

translations.literal: Seyu as gong, shang unknown, Qiandai as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: With Seyu as tonic the matching shang pipe goes unrecorded; Qiandai supplies zhi.

sentences.zh: 六日。

translations.literal: Six days.
translations.idiomatic: Occupies six days in the cycle.

sentences.zh: 律，八寸九分小分八微強。

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun nine fen plus eight micro-fen, slightly strong.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe measure 8.98+ strong micro-fen.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺九寸萬五千九百七十三。

translations.literal: Regulator: eight chi nine cun plus 15,973 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator line 8 chi 9 cun and 15,973 residual ticks.

sentences.zh: 執始，十七萬四千七百六十二。

translations.literal: Zhishi: 174,762.
translations.idiomatic: Zhishi solid: 174,762.

sentences.zh: 下生去滅。

translations.literal: Generates Qumie below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Qumie.

sentences.zh: 執始為宮，時息商，去滅徵。

translations.literal: Zhishi as gong, Shixi as shang, Qumie as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Zhishi gong, Shixi shang, Qumie zhi.

sentences.zh: 六日。

translations.literal: Six days.
translations.idiomatic: Six-day span.

sentences.zh: 律，八寸八分小分七大強。

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun eight fen plus seven micro-fen, greatly strong.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe 8.87+ marked strong.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺八寸萬五千五百一十六。

translations.literal: Regulator: eight chi eight cun plus 15,516 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator 8 chi 8 cun, remainder 15,516.

sentences.zh: 丙盛，十七萬二千四百一十。

translations.literal: Bingsheng: 172,410.
translations.idiomatic: Bingsheng solid: 172,410.

sentences.zh: 下生安度。

translations.literal: Generates Andu below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Andu.

sentences.zh: 丙盛為宮，屈齊商，安度徵。

translations.literal: Bingsheng as gong, Juqi as shang, Andu as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Bingsheng gong, Juqi shang, Andu zhi.

sentences.zh: 六日。

translations.literal: Six days.
translations.idiomatic: Six days.

sentences.zh: 律，八寸七分小分六微弱。

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun seven fen plus six micro-fen, slightly weak.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe 8.76 slightly weak.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺七寸萬一千六百七十九。

translations.literal: Regulator: eight chi seven cun plus 11,679 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator 8 chi 7 cun, remainder 11,679.

sentences.zh: 分動，十七萬八十九。

translations.literal: Fendong: 170,089.
translations.idiomatic: Fendong solid: 170,089.

sentences.zh: 下生歸嘉。

translations.literal: Generates Guijia below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Guijia.

sentences.zh: 分動為宮，隨期商，歸嘉徵。

translations.literal: Fendong as gong, Suiqi as shang, Guijia as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Fendong gong, Suiqi shang, Guijia zhi.

sentences.zh: 六日。

translations.literal: Six days.
translations.idiomatic: Six-day allocation.

sentences.zh: 律，八寸六分小分四強。

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun six fen plus four micro-fen, strong.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe 8.64 strong.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺六寸八千一百五十二。

translations.literal: Regulator: eight chi six cun plus 8,152 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator 8 chi 6 cun, remainder 8,152.

sentences.zh: 質末，十六萬七千八百。

translations.idiomatic: Zimo solid: 167,800.

sentences.zh: 下生否與。

translations.literal: Generates Fouyu below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Fouyu.

sentences.zh: 質末為宮，形晉商，否與徵。

translations.literal: Zimo as gong, Xingjin as shang, Fouyu as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Zimo gong, Xingjin shang, Fouyu zhi.

sentences.zh: 六日。

translations.literal: Six days.
translations.idiomatic: Six days.

sentences.zh: 律，八寸五分小分二強。

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun five fen plus two micro-fen, strong.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe 8.52 strong.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺五寸四千九百四十五。

translations.literal: Regulator: eight chi five cun plus 4,945 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator 8 chi 5 cun, remainder 4,945.

sentences.zh: 大呂，十六萬五千八百八十八。

translations.idiomatic: Dalü solid: 165,888.

sentences.zh: 下生夷則。

translations.literal: Generates Yize below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Yize.

sentences.zh: 大呂為宮，夾鐘商，夷則徵。

translations.literal: Dalü as gong, Jiazhong as shang, Yize as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Dalü gong, Jiazhong shang, Yize zhi.

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun four fen plus three micro-fen, weak.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe 8.43 weak.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺四寸五千五百八。

translations.literal: Regulator: eight chi four cun plus 5,508 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator 8 chi 4 cun, remainder 5,508.

sentences.zh: 分否，十六萬三千六百五十四。

translations.literal: Fenfou: 163,654.
translations.idiomatic: Fenfou solid: 163,654.

sentences.zh: 下生解形。

translations.literal: Generates Jiexing below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Jiexing.

sentences.zh: 分否為宮，開時商，解形徵。

translations.literal: Fenfou as gong, Kaishi as shang, Jiexing as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Fenfou gong, Kaishi shang, Jiexing zhi.

sentences.zh: 八日。

translations.literal: Eight days.
translations.idiomatic: Eight days.

sentences.zh: 律，八寸三分小分一強。

translations.literal: Pipe: eight cun three fen plus one micro-fen, strong.
translations.idiomatic: Pipe 8.31 strong.

sentences.zh: 準，八尺三寸二千八百五十一。

translations.literal: Regulator: 8 chi 3 cun plus 2,851 micro-units.
translations.idiomatic: Regulator: 8 chi 3 cun plus 2,851 micro-units.

sentences.zh: 凌陰，十六萬一千四百五十二。

translations.literal: Lingyin: 161,452.
translations.idiomatic: Lingyin solidity: 161,452.

sentences.zh: 下生去南。

translations.literal: Generates Qunan below.
translations.idiomatic: Down-generates Qunan.

sentences.zh: 凌陰為宮，族嘉商，去南徵。

translations.literal: Lingyin as gong, Zujia as shang, Qunan as zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Mode: Lingyin tonic, Zujia shang, Qunan zhi.

sentences.zh: 八日。

translations.literal: 8 days.

sentences.zh: 冬至之日，樹八尺之表，日中視其晷。

sentences.zh: 晷如度者其歲美，人民和順。

sentences.zh: 晷進則水，晷退則旱。

sentences.zh: 進一尺則日食，退一尺則月食。
